title: When do destructors run?
expectedStdout:
+ global
main starts
+ a
+ b
+ inner
- inner
+ heap
- heap
main ends
- b
- a
- global
tryThis: Remove `delete h;`: `- heap` disappears. A dynamic object is destroyed only when you `delete` it.
Throw an exception inside the inner block and catch it in `main`: `- inner` still prints. Destructors run during stack unwinding, which is what makes RAII exception-safe.
